items.text: Lakeside Internal Medicine has three admin staff: Priya (practice manager), Tomas (reception) and Ulla (records).
Every specialist referral gets one follow-up call exactly one week after the specialist appointment, booked as a 30-minute phone slot at 14:00 in the practice calendar.
Confirmation letters for follow-up calls go out to the patient on the same day the call slot is booked, stating the call date and the specialist involved.
All outgoing referral letters go on the practice letterhead signed by the referring physician.
Marta Levin, born 1958, is a registered patient at Lakeside Internal Medicine.
Marta Levin reported recurrent chest pain during exertion and needs a cardiology workup.

Marta Levin's cardiology referral letter was sent to Dr. Novak at Northgate Cardiology, and her specialist appointment is Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 10:30.

On the day Marta Levin's follow-up call slot is booked, a confirmation letter goes out to her stating the call date and the specialist who saw her.
